title: The ground here is going down
text: Taking the oil out from under this field has made the ground sink. The middle of the field has dropped as much as eight feet, and the field as a whole goes down about nine inches a year. Radar satellites watched parts of it fall more than an inch a month through 1995 and 1996.

s2.title: Lost Hills Oil Field
s2.quote: Portions of the hills overlying the oil field have subsided up to 8 feet (2.4 m) in the central region of operations, and subsidence occurs field-wide at a rate of about 9 inches (230 mm) per year.
